failure.message: The workflow pre-acquired fzy, then the calibration helper attempted a second acquisition. The existing active target correctly caused acquisition to refuse before any scenario launch.
failure.target_cleanup: Cleanup was invoked with the report-required mode and failed because no scenario report existed. Storage verification passed; the active source is retained in the failed job artifact for diagnosis.

corrective_action: Remove redundant workflow-level target acquisition; let each baseline/fault/restored phase acquire, build and clean its own exact source. Select no-case cleanup when an interrupted phase has no target reports, and surface bounded helper output in the workflow log.

subsequent_attempts.failure: F01 baseline and corrupted scenario reports were generated, but the immutable cleanup receipt name was reused across phases and caused a collision. No calibration or cleanup credit is claimed.
The declared F01 detection contract did not match the observed report category and step. Fault output diagnostics were added; no scenario or calibration credit is claimed.

The observed F02 detection was state_assertion_failure at step 6, not assertion_timeout at step 3. The exact public output-byte checkpoint captured the selected wrong candidate. F02 declaration was corrected to the observed boundary; no calibration credit is claimed.

scope: Preserves the initial no-launch workflow failure and three subsequent corrective attempts. Later attempts produced partial target reports but failed before a complete audited host matrix; no project admission credit is claimed.
